name: GetManyListenerCertificates
label: Get Many AWS ELB Listener Certificates
description: Retrieves all certificates associated with an AWS Elastic Load Balancer (ALB/NLB) listener.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: ReturnAll
fields.label: Return All
fields.description: If enabled, retrieves all certificates (no pagination). Otherwise, limits results by 'Limit'.

fields.name: Limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of certificates to return (max 100). Default: 100.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the load balancer is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: Certificates
fields.label: Certificates
fields.description: List of certificates associated with the listener.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS ELB.
